12931983fcea.title: Next sentence branch

b602d8ab0ed3.sentence: Some cells switch into a resistant state, changing color and becoming harder to move.

fe3336c95bbb.sentence: The outer edge becomes more active than the center as growth shifts toward nutrient-rich boundaries.

1f914b93b2b7.sentence: Collisions rotate cells into alignment, creating flowing lanes through dense regions.
1f914b93b2b7.title: Next sentence branch

3d258e698ba8.sentence: Periodic pulses of fresh nutrients create expanding waves of movement and division.
3d258e698ba8.title: Next sentence branch

79155f9c5aa1.sentence: Waste buildup darkens old regions and pushes new growth outward.

ab2a16ddcf69.sentence: Small gaps open inside dense patches, forming channels that let particles and cells flow through.

58b5c274bdf4.sentence: Long microtubule “tracks” radiate from a central centrosome, with small vesicle spheres “walking” along them via stepwise motion, sometimes detaching, switching tracks, and fusing with a target membrane sphere that changes color where fusion occurs.
58b5c274bdf4.title: Core sentence

6e44530c542b.sentence: A cell sphere with many small external particles shows membrane regions curving in to wrap and pinch off endocytic vesicles, while internal vesicles move outward and merge with the membrane to release particles that scatter and slowly diffuse away.
6e44530c542b.title: Core sentence

8c49516bae46.sentence: Multiple elongated mitochondria shapes inside a cell gently move, split, and merge, with glowing particles streaming into them and dimmer particles emitted, while their brightness fluctuates to show changing activity and a label shows “ATP level.”
8c49516bae46.title: Core sentence

27b24aabc760.sentence: A deformable immune cell blob slowly moves toward a smaller bacterium capsule, extending and retracting pseudopod-like protrusions; upon collision it wraps around and engulfs the bacterium, which fades as digestion particles swirl inside.
27b24aabc760.title: Core sentence

0e7689d7ee2a.sentence: A network of thin internal compartments (ER-like tubes) inside a cell lights up with a traveling calcium wave: small bright particles rapidly spread, bounce at boundaries, then are reabsorbed into pumps, as a color bar tracks local calcium concentration over time.
0e7689d7ee2a.title: Core sentence

53ef774bb1e8.sentence: A single cell sphere gradually grows in size and changes color as it progresses through labeled phases (G1, S, G2, M) on a circular “clock” ring beside it; during S phase tiny DNA dots duplicate, and during M phase the cell splits into two smaller spheres.
53ef774bb1e8.title: Core sentence

b251b98b86c0.sentence: Dozens of small cells float and gently jostle in a transparent box, emitting and absorbing colored signal particles; when one cell receives above-threshold signals, it glows brighter and triggers neighboring cells to light up in a spreading wave.
b251b98b86c0.title: Core sentence

4b7f806b8819.sentence: A cell is represented as a soft sphere made of many connected small beads that can stretch and compress as it squeezes through a narrow channel, with internal particles shifting and colliding as the membrane deforms and then relaxes.
4b7f806b8819.title: Core sentence

abf605bfbf9e.sentence: Fluorescent cargo vesicles containing colored particles move randomly until they collide with larger acidic lysosome spheres, which they fuse with; inside, cargo particles slowly shrink and disappear while the lysosome briefly glows brighter.
abf605bfbf9e.title: Core sentence

112d0bcbc455.sentence: Stacked, curved Golgi cisternae are shown as layered translucent plates, with vesicles attaching to the cis side, moving from one cisterna to the next, changing color as they “mature,” then detaching and shooting off toward the membrane.
112d0bcbc455.title: Core sentence

c410f902dd35.sentence: A stylized cell shows mitochondria, ribosomes, and nucleus as factory stations connected by glowing “energy” streams; raw material particles enter from the membrane, travel along paths, collide with stations, and emerge as “product” particles that exit the cell.
c410f902dd35.title: Core sentence

68463db6db3e.sentence: A cell sphere is filled with dynamic actin filaments represented by flexible rods that grow, shrink, and branch; as filaments elongate at one side and disassemble at another, the overall cell shape bulges, retracts, and slowly crawls across the floor.
68463db6db3e.title: Core sentence

8ae6b382924d.sentence: Several cells rest on a flat surface plane, tethered by short “adhesion” springs that can attach and break; as external flow (gentle directional push) acts, some cells slide, roll, or detach and drift away, with adhesion springs stretching and snapping.
8ae6b382924d.title: Core sentence

7ab18a04768a.sentence: A cluster of identical pale cells slowly changes as some receive “signals” (colored particles) and transition into distinct types with new colors and shapes; neighboring cells are more likely to differentiate when close to an already changed cell, creating branching patterns.
7ab18a04768a.title: Core sentence

315acc32fe43.sentence: Virus particles with spiky shells drift toward a larger cell, bind to specific receptor spots on its membrane, then either inject a glowing “genome” filament that spreads inside or are endocytosed into vesicles that move toward the center and release contents.
315acc32fe43.title: Core sentence

d35440a234eb.sentence: A cell sphere in a box with many water particles outside and fewer inside shows water particles crossing the semi-permeable membrane; as flows change, the cell slowly swells or shrinks, with a radial grid and numeric label tracking cell volume.
d35440a234eb.title: Core sentence

348841d11b31.sentence: A central cell body sphere sprouts branching cylindrical dendrites and a long axon; signal particles start at synapse spheres, travel along dendrites toward the cell body, then trigger a bright pulse that races along the axon, leaving a fading trail.
348841d11b31.title: Core sentence

c98d0d22a003.sentence: Damaged organelles marked by flickering colors float inside a cell until a double-membrane “autophagosome” shell grows around them, wraps and closes, then moves to fuse with a lysosome, where the contents dissolve into smaller recyclable particles.
c98d0d22a003.title: Core sentence

6e01cce8bb20.sentence: Starting from a single cell on a flat surface, cells periodically replicate into two that gently push, collide, and rearrange, forming an expanding dome-shaped colony whose overall boundary is highlighted and whose inner cells become more tightly packed over time.
6e01cce8bb20.title: Core sentence

d06a66ee7401.sentence: A cell is visualized like a small city with a central “city hall” nucleus, power plant mitochondria, and road-like cytoskeletal tracks; different colored vehicles (vesicles) follow these tracks, stop at “stations,” transfer cargo, and occasionally collide and reroute.
d06a66ee7401.title: Core sentence

bee2b267be28.sentence: A healthy cell sphere gradually shrinks, its membrane blebs into small bubbles, and internal structures condense; the cell breaks into many apoptotic bodies that drift away until neighboring scavenger cells engulf and clear them.
bee2b267be28.title: Core sentence

eced8a63419a.sentence: Numerous receptor rods embedded in the cell membrane tilt, rotate, and randomly “scan” the outside; when specific ligand particles collide and attach, the receptor changes shape and triggers a chain of glowing particles moving inward toward the nucleus.
eced8a63419a.title: Core sentence

4c614df075a0.sentence: A transparent spherical cell with a semi-permeable membrane where colored particle “molecules” bounce, pass through channels, and get wrapped into vesicles that bud, move along filament “microtubules,” and fuse with organelles.
4c614df075a0.title: Core sentence
